summaryZh: WSIL研究组研究MIMO无线通信的物理模型、可重构天线和波束控制，探索中高频段通信、感知辅助链路配置及能效。方法包括电路与电磁学约束建模、天线仿真与原型、预编码算法，以及机器学习和强化学习。
researchQuestions: 如何把电路和电磁学约束纳入MIMO信息与通信理论？
如何利用可重构天线、感知信息和学习算法降低链路配置开销与能耗？
topics: 可重构天线与三混合架构
methods: 电路与电磁学约束建模

evidence.quote: Welcome to the WSIL research page! This page provides a snapshot of current and ongoing research projects in Professor Robert Heath’s research group at UC San Diego.

The WSIL and external collaborators are progressing in developing information and communication theory based on physically consistent models. This results in research that leverages circuits and electromagnetics to introduce new approaches for analyzing systems, devising performance bounds, and designing algorithms.

Our current work involves devising new models for reconfigurable antennas, simulating and prototyping the antennas, and developing algorithms to integrate the antennas into MIMO systems as part of the tri-hybrid MIMO architecture.

The WSIL is developing strategies for reducing the overheads in configuring MIMO communication links by exploiting location and sensing information. We continue to develop AI/ML strategies for uncovering the relationships between sensor data and communication strategies.
The WSIL is investigating how reinforcement learning can solve challenging problems in MIMO link configuration.
Our research develops algorithms that explore these tradeoffs, combining PHY-layer (link-level) with system-level optimization and AI-driven adaptation .

The WSIL is exploring methods to address these new challenges. One line of research is to understand when and how near-field communication can be useful for multiuser MIMO in the upper mid-band frequencies.
WSIL group Prof. Robert W. Heath Jr.
Energy efficiency (EE) and sustainability are key metrics in 6G radio access networks (RAN).
We are currently developing precoding and combining algorithms for the tri-hybrid architecture and studying how the architecture adapts to different types of antennas.
